summary: Audited every current Studio and Oversight branch with exact GitHub compare-to-main, PR merge/closed status, branch protection readback, CI workflow triggers, personal-account ownership and runtime DB presence. Two Studio branches are ancestor-only and safe to delete: design/hyperscale-coordination-v1 and feature/studio-inbox-evidence-v1; obsolete closed GOAP PR16 and revert-24 branch require confirmation; audit/v1-500-worker-qa and studio/v1-operational-consolidation each have one unmerged audit file and must be archived first. main, studio/runtime, studio/comms, oversight main/cases are active branches. PR31 merged at 8d0b9002 and its design branch was deleted by other actor. Both repos remain private with protected:false and rulesets GET 403 plan restriction. Current scheduled broker/reconcile/director workflows push directly to studio/comms and studio/runtime with github.token, so requiring PRs before dedicated app publishing would break them. Recommended separate human-reviewed and append-only branch rules, least-privilege org/app strategy. No actual PostgreSQL deployment/migration/credentials/queue exist; DB is only a merged architecture plan. No branches deleted or settings changed by this audit.
